title: Gabriel Vasquez
intro:
Gabriel Vasquez (Democratic Party) (also known as Gabe) is a member of the U.S. House, representing New Mexico's 2nd Congressional District. He assumed office on January 3, 2023. His current term ends on January 3, 2027.
Vasquez (Democratic Party) is running for re-election to the U.S. House to represent New Mexico's 2nd Congressional District. He is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026. He advanced from the Democratic primary on June 2, 2026.
